Parametric one-loop four-point conformal integral in $D$ dimensions with arbitrary propagator powers $a_1,a_2,a_3,a_4$ obeying $a_1+a_2+a_3+a_4=D$ (conformality condition). Defined in position space as $I_4^{a}(x) = \int d^D x_0 / \pi^{D/2} \prod_{i=1}^{4} X_{0i}^{-a_i}$ with $X_{ij}=(x_i-x_j)^2$ (Eq. 2.1). Evaluated in closed form via the bipartite Mellin-Barnes representation as a $Z_4$-invariant sum of four Appell $F_4$ basis functions generated by cyclic permutations from a single master function (Eqs. 5.17-5.18). Cross-ratios $u=X_{12} X_{34}/(X_{13} X_{24})$, $v=X_{14} X_{23}/(X_{13} X_{24})$. Non-parametric limit $a_i=1$, $D=4$ reproduces the Bloch-Wigner / Davydychev form in terms of the Bloch-Wigner function $\Phi(z,y)$.

Records.description: One-loop massive Bhabha scattering family with 5 master integrals (tadpole T1, two bubbles T2(t) and T3(s), one vertex T4(t), one box T5(s,t)). Massive electron line, massless photon exchange. Canonical UT basis g_1..g_5 constructed via Magnus exponential of the eps^0 part of the DE matrix; the resulting canonical system d g = eps d hat{A}_1 g is logarithmic in Landau variables x,y defined by s=-m^2(1-x)^2/x and t=-m^2(1-y)^2/y, with seven letters {x,1+x,y,1+y,1-y,x+y,1+xy}. Same MIs are reused as one-loop x one-loop subtopologies of the two-loop QED vertex family. Cross-checked against Henn-Smirnov 1307.4083.

One-loop four-mass box integral family with four distinct external masses m1, m2, m3, m4 and massless internal propagators. All symbol letters (rational and algebraic) are derived from minors of the 5x5 Q matrix associated with the Baikov representation. The rational letters reproduce W_1,...,W_10,W_13,W_18 of He et al. (2022); 14 algebraic letters involving square roots of Q_{ii} are also obtained, equivalent to W_21,...,W_30,W_46,W_62,W_51,W_59 of He et al.

Records.description: One-loop four-mass box integral I_{a,b,c,d} of dual-conformal-invariant N=4 SYM amplitudes. In dual coordinates the integrand reads -x_{ac}^2 x_{bd}^2 Delta / (x_{0a}^2 x_{0b}^2 x_{0c}^2 x_{0d}^2). UV/IR finite because all four corners are massive (each corner is a cluster of two or more external null momenta of the parent amplitude). Closed-form evaluation in eq. (3.4): I = -Li_2(z) + Li_2(zbar) - (1/2) log(z*zbar) log((1-z)/(1-zbar)), with z, zbar defined through the cross-ratios u = p1^2*p3^2/(s*t), v = p2^2*p4^2/(s*t) and Delta = sqrt((1-u-v)^2 - 4*u*v). This box is the carrier of the algebraic letters Delta_{a,b,c,d} that show up in the symbol of two-loop NMHV n-point amplitudes via the Q-bar equation.

One-loop scalar box $D^{(1)}(k_1^2,k_2^2,k_3^2,k_4^2,s,t)$ with massless internal propagators and all four external momenta off-shell. Via a two-fold MB representation, reduces to the one-loop triangle via variable pairing $X=k_1^2 k_3^2/(s t), Y=k_2^2 k_4^2/(s t)$, giving $D^{(1)} = (i \pi^2/(s t)) \Phi^{(1)}(X,Y)$.
